Hi Tom / Amy —

Quick follow-up on the outstanding invoice INV-2027-311 (due this Friday, 4/16). We received the signed ACH authorization but I want to confirm a couple of small items before finance initiates the pull:

2) Entity mapping for VAT: the invoice was issued to Calcadia Health (EUR entity) but we have an onboarding note showing two legal entities. If this goes to an EU entity, do you expect VAT reverse-charge, or do you want us to gross-up? Please provide the EU VAT number if reverse-charge applies.

3) Target collect date: our billing ops can initiate ACH on Friday 4/16 morning US-PST if you sign off by end of day tomorrow. If you need a later settlement, tell us the date and we can schedule.

Attached: signed ACH authorization (Calcadia_ACH_Authority_signed.pdf) and the invoice (Invoice_INV-2027-311.pdf).

If it's easier, I can hop on a quick 10-minute call with your AP to confirm.

Thanks —
